interfaces_or_endpoints: Provider-neutral LanguageModel boundary uses OpenAI as the current adapter; validated tool selection leads to one code-controlled execution and a no-tools completion using only an approved reply-safe result view

Authenticated MCP catalog admits only bot-owned policies supported by discovery; workforce status uses get_current_work_status(statuses?, limit, offset) from pre-release MCP 1.3.0, while detailed get_current_attendance is never offered to workforce requests because REST limits it to administrators

Own and exact-selector administrator history page through inclusive 31-day requests over at most twelve calendar months; workforce status pages through get_current_work_status with one validated optional status set and accepts only first_name, last_name, and status; the bot never sends an as_of or identity selector for workforce status
Name search renders deterministic directory-safe candidates and requires a newly messaged listed username or email before a later exact-selector attendance read; resolved IDs remain internal

Two-stage LLM routing makes a pre-auth guidance decision from bot-owned read-only action definitions and an unverified presentation-only Teams display name; safe greeting, clarification, and attendance-only scope guidance end with zero SSO/OBO/MCP/REST activity, while a validated selection enters the existing single SSO/OBO and live MCP catalog admission path

TEAMS-LLM-GUIDANCE-ROUTING-001 verification: `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_authenticated_handler.py tests/unit/test_agent_orchestrator.py tests/unit/test_openai_language_model.py tests/integration/test_authenticated_attendance_flow.py -q` (20 passed), `uv run pytest -q` (136 passed), `uv run ruff check src tests` (passed), `uv run ruff format --check src tests` (54 files already formatted), and `uv run mypy --strict src` (Success: no issues found in 29 source files); MCP 1.2.0 and REST v1 contracts, OBO handling, live-catalog authority, and downstream interfaces are unchanged

Pilot source slice: guidance uses a validated pre-auth intent and fixed English/Slovenian copy without SSO/OBO/MCP/REST; post-result model calls cannot execute tools, and model-visible projections omit personal names, event details, IDs, notes, locations, and raw source records. Replies render facts in code as localized chronological/status-grouped, numbered batches with a final completion marker; delivery stops on the first failed send and logs only correlation ID, completed/total count, and exception type. Read-only personal chat is the initial pilot scope, not a permanent limit.

REST v1/1.0.0 and pre-release MCP 1.3.0 version labels remain unchanged; MCP migration uses get_current_work_status and leaves the detailed tool administrator-only.

TEAMS-POSTGRES-CONVERSATION-MEMORY-001 source slice: optional asyncpg PostgreSQL memory derives an opaque key from canonical Bot Service tenant/AAD identifiers, carries one bounded untrusted history snapshot through both model calls, and saves only user text plus approved non-factual guidance/framing after complete reply delivery. It retains at most twenty seven-day messages, truncates stored content after 4,000 characters, uses transaction-scoped advisory locks for schema/trim/cleanup operations and stateless two-second outage fallback; startup publishes a pool only after schema success, cancellation disposes it, and close bounds graceful shutdown then terminates. Whole identifier matching is enforced before and after authenticated catalog admission, so historical selector substrings cannot target another employee. A copied Compose dotenv filters only case-insensitive POSTGRES_DB, POSTGRES_USER, and POSTGRES_PASSWORD before strict validation: known bot fields remain validated, all other unknown dotenv keys and unknown initialization keywords are rejected, blank optional DATABASE_URL remains stateless, and malformed URLs remain redacted. Verification: `TEST_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://memory_test:synthetic-password@127.0.0.1:55433/attendance_memory_test uv run pytest -q` (200 passed, no skips), including PostgreSQL 17 atomic exchange rollback and >1,000-row maintenance cleanup; Ruff check/format, strict mypy (32 source files), explicit synthetic Compose config with `--env-file /dev/null`, Docker image build, state JSON, and diff check passed. README records a reproducible manual named-volume restart procedure; it is not claimed as an automated test.

PostgreSQL-backed history continuation source slice: one 15-minute active record per authenticated tenant/AAD-user and Teams conversation stores only typed query shape, next offset, language, expiry, and a short lease. Buttons carry an opaque UUID; both button clicks and exact English/Slovenian typed continuation phrases claim that same record, then perform fresh SSO, OBO, live MCP catalog admission, and one page read. Delivered pages advance or clear the cursor; failures release it. Verification: 198 local tests passed with five PostgreSQL tests skipped when no synthetic database is configured; an isolated PostgreSQL 17 run passed 203 tests with no skips, with Ruff, formatting, and strict mypy passing.

Production identity mapping and attendance-data behavior require end-to-end verification against the deployed attendance-mcp boundary and Attendance REST API.
